text:
You need a brand identity and launch strategy for a GCC-facing athlete recovery product line that can stand out in a competitive, high-end market.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be glad to help you shape a clear, premium brand for your cold plunge and recovery products. I bring 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP, working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and related tooling. While my background is technical, I’m comfortable using research, data, and structured analysis to support brand decisions, audience understanding, and messaging development—especially where a new product needs a strong position in the market.

For your project, I can help with the market research side by organizing competitive analysis, identifying audience segments, and translating findings into practical brand direction. I can also support the development of brand positioning, messaging, and a brand system that feels premium and credible for both personal and commercial buyers. Since your audience is in the GCC region, I would approach the brand with sensitivity to Arabic-origin preferences and the expectations of a sports and wellness market.

I can also assist in shaping the communication framework across digital and social channels, and I’m comfortable collaborating with design and product teams to keep the brand consistent across touchpoints, including the Shopify store experience. If needed, I can help structure the UX thinking behind the storefront so the brand story and product presentation feel aligned.

A relevant project from my background is Grocery demand forecasting for Marrow & Pine Grocers, where I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. That work reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and cut spoilage write-offs by 11% in pilot stores. The project is different from branding, but it reflects my ability to work from data, create useful systems, and deliver outcomes that support business decisions.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss how I can help you define a strong brand foundation for this launch.
